The '''Separatist Congress Leader''' served as a leader of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]] held this position in c. [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
